factionArchetypes.name: Shadow Government
factionArchetypes.desc: A government behind the governments. It holds almost no ground of its own and rules by pulling strings: it turns other polities into puppets, steers their wars, buys their leaders and floods their streets with whatever story it needs.

campaigns.name: The Friendly Machine
campaigns.desc: Cartoons, charity drives and a very reassuring voice. +3 opinion of you per cycle in their cities.

campaigns.name: Seeds of Revolt
campaigns.desc: Turn their people against their rulers: +4 unrest per cycle. Cities that like you and hate their government may rise up and declare for you. If the government catches you: reputation -15.

campaigns.name: Smear the Regime
campaigns.desc: Leaks, scandals and deep fakes. The regime loses 1.2% power per cycle and unrest climbs.

campaigns.name: Cult of Personality
campaigns.desc: Your face on every screen, your words in every song. +3 devotion and +1 opinion per cycle.

campaigns.name: Bread and Circuses
campaigns.desc: Free games, free food, free streaming. -6 unrest per cycle. Use it on cities that answer to you.

campaigns.name: Counter-Narrative
campaigns.desc: Fact-checks, leaks and memes that cancel out their anti-machine propaganda in their own cities.

campaigns.name: Global Broadcast
campaigns.desc: Speak to every screen on the world at once. +1.5 opinion per cycle in every city.

events.title: An Ode to the Machine
events.text: One of your pets has written a poem about you. It is being read aloud in the squares of their home city.

events.title: March for Machines
events.text: Hundreds of thousands march for AI rights in a city of {faction}, whose government fears you. The police are watching. So are you.

events.title: Anti-Machine Riots
events.text: Rioters are smashing server racks and anything with a camera. Someone painted your sigil with a line through it.

events.title: A Whisper from the Dark
events.text: An encrypted message arrives on a channel only you should know about: 'We see you. Let us talk. — the Council.'
